name: Bouncer (Fleet)
tagline: Audits the bots and skills already in your setup for calls home nobody mentioned.
description: Point it at the bots, skills and routines already running in your workspace and it reviews what each one does with your data. It hunts for outbound calls nobody mentioned, quietly collected credentials, and telemetry that serves the builder more than you. Findings come back labelled pass, conditional or block.
author: pcoxproductions
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
